{
  "job_id": "DIRECTOR-FAILOVER-FULL-TEST-20260907",
  "department": "POSE_CAMERA",
  "status": "REPAIR",
  "pose_camera_decisions": {
    "identity_dependency": "Pose and camera integration is conditional because the authoritative Inaria identity specification, reference version, and change log are unavailable. Pose and camera must not alter, obscure, or compensate for unresolved identity, clothing, or scene decisions.",
    "pose_design": {
      "primary_pose": "Neutral ergonomic standing pose with weight distributed primarily over both feet, one foot slightly advanced, relaxed shoulders, natural spinal alignment, elbows softly bent, and hands visible near the sides without contact with the face or torso.",
      "alternate_pose": "Supported seated pose with both feet grounded, knees aligned with the feet, upright but relaxed torso, one forearm resting naturally on the thigh, and the other hand visible and separated from clothing and furniture.",
      "gesture_options": [
        "Relaxed open hands with separated fingers and no extreme finger articulation.",
        "One arm bent at approximately 70 to 100 degrees while the opposite arm remains relaxed.",
        "Subtle directional weight shift without deep hip compression, twisting, or unstable balance.",
        "Small head turn or mild three-quarter orientation while keeping both eyes, jawline, and facial landmarks readable."
      ],
      "hands": [
        "Keep both hands fully visible whenever possible.",
        "Use simple relaxed configurations with naturally curved fingers and clear thumb placement.",
        "Avoid fists, tightly interlocked fingers, hands behind the back, hands pressed against the face, and overlapping hands.",
        "Maintain separation from garments, props, body edges, and background clutter."
      ],
      "feet": [
        "Keep both feet grounded with clear contact shadows and readable shoe or foot boundaries.",
        "Use parallel or mildly outward-facing feet with stable spacing approximately hip-width apart.",
        "Avoid crossed ankles, extreme tiptoe positions, deep lunges, floating feet, hidden soles, and ambiguous footwear intersections.",
        "Coordinate foot placement with the scene ground plane and camera perspective."
      ],
      "joints_and_anatomy": [
        "Maintain believable shoulder, elbow, wrist, hip, knee, and ankle alignment.",
        "Avoid extreme joint flexion, forced contortions, overlapping limbs, unnatural limb shortening, and hidden elbows or knees.",
        "Preserve consistent body proportions and silhouette across all pose variants.",
        "Prioritize anatomy readability over dramatic gesture."
      ],
      "balance_and_contact": [
        "Use stable center-of-mass placement over the support polygon.",
        "Require plausible contact between feet and ground or between seated body and support surface.",
        "Include consistent contact shadows and avoid floating, sinking, or sliding body parts.",
        "Do not introduce props that require complex gripping or load-bearing interaction during this test."
      ]
    },
    "camera_design": {
      "primary_camera": "Eye-level three-quarter camera with a normal or mild telephoto perspective, centered on the upper torso and face while retaining sufficient negative space around the full silhouette.",
      "framing_variants": [
        "Full-body vertical framing with feet and ground contact visible.",
        "Three-quarter framing from head to below the knees with hands and major joints unobstructed.",
        "Waist-up identity-support framing for facial and upper-body evaluation."
      ],
      "perspective": [
        "Use natural perspective with minimal wide-angle distortion.",
        "Keep camera height, focal length, and subject distance consistent within each comparison group.",
        "Avoid extreme low-angle, high-angle, fisheye, foreshortened, or close-range perspectives that distort anatomy.",
        "Maintain believable verticals, horizon placement, and subject scale relative to the scene."
      ],
      "composition": [
        "Reserve clear negative space around the head, hands, feet, elbows, knees, and silhouette.",
        "Avoid cropping hands, feet, joints, or hairline in anatomy and identity validation samples.",
        "Keep the face sufficiently large and evenly lit for identity review.",
        "Use controlled asymmetry in composition without allowing the subject to merge with environmental edges."
      ],
      "camera_variation": [
        "Vary azimuth modestly between frontal, slight three-quarter, and side-adjacent views.",
        "Vary camera distance and framing in controlled groups rather than changing every camera variable simultaneously.",
        "Keep one reference camera configuration fixed for failover parity and QA comparison."
      ]
    },
    "generation_stability": [
      "Prefer static, low-complexity poses with readable limb separation and limited occlusion.",
      "Use simple hand states, stable footwear, grounded stance, and uncluttered interaction geometry.",
      "Keep pose, camera, lighting, and scene changes coordinated so failures can be attributed to a single variable.",
      "Reject outputs with extra limbs, fused fingers, malformed joints, asymmetrical eyes caused by perspective, floating feet, broken contact, severe foreshortening, or ambiguous silhouette.",
      "Do not generate production assets; this is a specification and routing test only."
    ],
    "diversity_gate_plan": [
      "Pass only if pose families include at least one neutral standing and one supported seated configuration without changing identity-bearing traits.",
      "Pass only if camera families include frontal or near-frontal, three-quarter, and controlled distance or framing variants.",
      "Do not count trivial crops or minor angle changes as independent diversity.",
      "Keep clothing, scene, pose, and camera variation attributable and reversible.",
      "Block diversity approval if anatomy stability, identity readability, or hand and foot visibility degrades."
    ],
    "handoff_result": "
